intro.title: Get each application ready, then send it yourself
intro.lead: Each week %BRAND% picks jobs from your search. You choose which ones to prepare a kit for.
intro.point_list: A weekly list of jobs that fit your search. You can add any job yourself.
intro.point_kit: For each job you choose, a kit: your resume tailored to the post, a cover letter when the post asks for one, and your saved answers.
intro.point_review: You check every kit before you use it. Anything new in your resume must be confirmed by you.
intro.point_open: You open the application on the company's site and send it yourself.
